Shipping a browser extension without a native host

Posted on Thursday · 4 min read · 12 comments

Most editors that promise Vim keys in the browser hand your text to another process and paste the result back. That works until the page has an opinion about its own input: a Markdown preview that re-renders on every keystroke, a form that validates as you type, an undo stack the site maintains itself.

The alternative is to edit the page's own text field in place and let the site see ordinary input events. It is less glamorous and it rules out a few things, but the result is a comment box that behaves like a comment box, only with modes.
